title: McpVerifyClaimInput
description: Input of verify_claim: one claim, the spans cited for it, and an optional numeric tuple. Sign is derived from numeric.value, never supplied.

items.description: A span reference with an optional verbatim quote.

value.description: Finite decimal string without exponent, at most 34 significant digits (the engine's Decimal precision).

scale.description: Base-ten exponent applied to value: one of NUMERIC_SCALE_EXPONENTS in fel_retrieval.generation.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (design contract §6.1). An ISO-8601 instant with an explicit offset, or a date meaning 00:00 America/New_York on that date. Naive datetimes are rejected. Must not precede 1994-01-01 or follow the request time; the server enforces the upper bound. Omitted means the request time. The instant used is echoed as evidence_context.effective_as_of.

timestamp_mode.description: strict (the default and the only hosted mode) shows a document only when its verified public_at (the instant it became public) is at or before the cutoff. approximate is self-hosted only and carries no temporal guarantee (design contract §6.2).

corpus_version_id.description: Corpus version to read. Omitted resolves to the active version; an unknown, unpublished or retired pin returns pin_unavailable, never a fallback.

verifier_version.description: Verifier version to apply. Omitted resolves to the active verifier; an unknown or retired version returns pin_unavailable.
